author: g. c. cheung
title: Texas State baseball secures walk-off win over UTRGV on March 24
text:
Texas State defeated UTRGV with an 8-7 walk-off victory at Bobcat Ballpark on March 24. The game ended when a Texas State player scored from second base on an infield single.
The result gives Texas State a season record of 16-8, while UTRGV falls to 13-12. The win was decided in the bottom of the ninth inning after Texas State capitalized on a throwing error and aggressive baserunning.
One Texas State player extended his hitting streak to 17 games by going 2-for-4 with a double and an RBI. Another contributed two hits, including a double, and scored twice. Two players each hit their seventh home runs of the season. On the mound, one pitcher earned his second win after pitching two innings with three strikeouts and allowing three unearned runs. Steven Oliva took the loss for UTRGV.
UTRGV built an early lead by scoring once in each of the first three innings. Texas State responded in the fourth with two runs, including a home run by Park and an RBI double that brought another runner home from first base. In subsequent innings, key doubles and home runs helped Texas State take control before defensive errors allowed UTRGV to tie it late.
The decisive moment came in the bottom of the ninth when Munguia entered as a pinch runner, stole second base, advanced to third on contact, and then slid safely into home for the winning run after a close play at the plate.
Looking ahead, Texas State will travel to Atlanta for a weekend series against Georgia State beginning Friday at 5 p.m.
